assets.title: Sales Quick Guide: SAP Customer Evolution Program
assets.description: Brochure providing sales guidance on why and how to move customers' legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA Cloud under the Customer Evolution Program (CEP).

assets.title: SAP Customer Evolution Kit — Value Proposition for Partners
assets.description: Sales presentation describing how partners leverage the SAP Customer Evolution Kit — a free, modular engagement model with pre-defined activities — to accelerate customers' transformation to cloud ERP.

assets.title: Partner-Led Migrations — SAP Enterprise Cloud Services Supported Migration Approaches
assets.description: Sales presentation detailing brownfield conversion scenarios and the migration / conversion approaches supported by SAP Enterprise Cloud Services. Highly relevant to brownfield conversion engagements.

assets.title: Using the Business Transformation Management Suite within the SAP Activate Methodology
assets.description: Sales presentation on Business Transformation Management challenges before, during, and after S/4HANA go-live, mapped to the SAP Activate methodology phases. Covers transition objectives, prioritisation, and stakeholder management.

assets.title: H.B. Fuller: Adhering to a clean core strategy on cloud ERP to execute a merger and acquisition strategy
assets.description: Customer Success Story covering H.B. Fuller's large-scale brownfield migration to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition using RISE with SAP and SAP Services & Support — clean core strategy underpinning M&A execution.

assets.title: YASH Technologies: Adopting data-driven guidance for transitioning to modern ERP in the private cloud
assets.description: Business Transformation Study showing how YASH Technologies accelerated their move to cloud ERP using a guided data-migration approach via the SAP Business Transformation Center.

assets.title: KUREHA Corporation: Taking a phased transition to a next-gen business foundation with full historical data
assets.description: Business Transformation Study covering KUREHA's company-code-based phased migration of historical data from legacy ECC to S/4HANA with minimal business disruption.

assets.title: How can companies validate their migrated data in a transition to a new ERP — SAP S/4HANA — in a tight timeframe?
assets.description: Business Transformation Study on a multinational consumer-goods company's 48-hour ERP cutover with high-quality data validation supported by SAP Services & Support.

assets.title: Clean Core Extensibility for SAP S/4HANA Cloud
assets.description: Thought leadership paper explaining the clean core strategy and SAP S/4HANA Cloud extensibility model — central to brownfield-to-cloud conversion design decisions.
